name: wildreach-survival
description: WILDREACH — Real-Time 3D Multiplayer Survival Game built with Three.js, TypeScript, Vite, Node.js, and Socket.IO

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,green "npm --workspace=server run dev" "npm --workspace=client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=shared run build && npm --workspace=server run build && npm --workspace=client run build && node scripts/sync-root-build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=server run typecheck && npm --workspace=client run typecheck
